text:
Hello, maine call kiya tha kyunki mera loan EMI overdue ho gaya hai. Actually, family mein medical emergency aa gaya tha, isliye account mein balance nahi tha aur payment time par nahi ho paya. Maine abhi funds arrange kar liye hain aur main aaj hi pay kar dunga, lekin maine dekha ki system mein late penalty lag gaya hai. 

Kya aap yeh late penalty wave off kar sakte hain? Ek genuine emergency thi yaar, please isko waive kar dijiye.
